Method of Attack: Banking trojan with code borrowed from Anubis
Using Android Accessibility feature to display overlays on apps to steal payment card data
Sending special command to open a webpage called Coronavirus Finder that lures victims into providing payment card data
Attack Vector: Fake push notifications exploiting Android Accessibility feature
Malicious webpage lure (Coronavirus Finder) claiming to show infected people nearby for a fee
Indicators of Compromise: Malware tagged as “flash-2” and previous versions tagged “flash-es12”
